title: Mirabel and the Protocol
author: Jonah Blackwood
blurb: Bram Iversen, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
